correctness.rationale: Build the 15 edges of Petersen KG(5,2) as matching-complex vertices. Independent enumeration gives 331 faces (15,75,145,90,6). Barycentric rank-ordered strict chains modulo even labels yield exactly 14,58,94,60,12 regular orbit cells, and integral alternating-deletion boundaries square to zero. An independent sparse integral ±1 cancellation, using a different high-degree pivot order, eliminates 118 pairs and leaves one degree-0 and one degree-2 generator with zero residual differentials, proving integral homology of S2 without torsion. Separately 61 exact fundamental-group Tietze eliminations show original matching complex simply connected. A 3-cycle fixes the barycenter of a matching 2-simplex; since A5 is simple, Armstrong gives trivial quotient pi1. Hurewicz and homological Whitehead make the S2 homotopy equivalence. No Borel quotient or general graph claim.
